hypothesis: A high-confidence learned endgame attack can retain at least 0.025 kills/game when it changes only BOMB decisions, requires BOMB to be among the frozen DQN's top three legal actions, caps learned bombs per round, and redirects only frozen follow-up actions without a safe continuation.
changed_factor: Both candidate arms use the fixed V12 t85 learned head only as a BOMB proposal. Movement proposals preserve the fallback. BOMB must have no more than two better legal DQN actions. After an accepted learned bomb, a seven-step follow-up preserves each DQN action with a ten-step survival continuation and otherwise selects the highest-Q legal continuation. The arms prospectively compare caps of one and three learned bomb overrides per round.
controls: Same frozen checkpoint, learned t85 artifact, empty-board context, broad persistent loop guard, action mask, scenarios, opponents, slots, evaluator, metrics, gates, and paired fresh seeds. No parameters, rewards, features, or DQN weights are changed.
selection: Among pilot-eligible fixed caps, choose the largest kill gain, then score gain, then the lower learned-bomb cap. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.
